## Budget vs. Revenue

This page compares the budgets versus revenues of films in the dataset. @fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between how much a film costs to produce and how much revenue it earns.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: "Relationship between film budgets and worldwide revenues."

# import libraries
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# load dataset
films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

# make scatter plot
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])

# adding labels
plt.xlabel("Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Film Budget vs. Revenue")

# display plot
plt.show()
```
